scope_note: Third corrective synthesis for Microsoft's Central Washington portfolio and unallocated MWH campus context. Source-modeled EY/IMPLAN operating and construction contribution outputs are preserved at Chelan-Douglas-Grant scope without conversion to selected-building effects. The direct-compensation proxy uses the reported 377 jobs and rounded $93,000 compensation at the same regional scope. Campus electricity savings are converted only to an average-load equivalent; QWRU water availability is converted only from cubic meters to gallons. Four complete MWH real-plus-personal tax-year totals and four equal-cost identities are retained for 2022-2025, but no actual public cost or net fiscal sign is asserted. Six county comparison gaps are low-confidence descriptive benchmarks for the separate 2007 Columbia event and 2015 MWH context, never causal effects. All estimates are unallocated to the 143,439-square-foot IM3 footprint and subject to explicit non-additivity.
